query: What blocks the Cedar cabinet order, and who coordinates delivery?

sources.title: DEMO: Cedar Cabinet Order
sources.text:
# DEMO: Cedar Cabinet Order

**Fictional demo data. This project, its people and its records are invented.**

The Cedar cabinet order is blocked by RFI-017, which is awaiting finish-selection approval. The order has not been released to the supplier.

The supplier contact is Ellis Pine at the invented company Cedar Cabinetry. This record does not include a purchase order number.

sources.title: DEMO: Cedar Delivery Coordination
sources.text:
# DEMO: Cedar Delivery Coordination

**Fictional demo data. This project, its people and its records are invented.**

Nora Elm coordinates delivery of the Cedar Remodel cabinets with the site team. The delivery target is 19 October 2026; it is not a confirmed booking.

Nora's coordination call with the site team is scheduled for 2 October 2026 at 14:00. Delivery confirmation depends on the cabinet order being released.
